src='''from collections import defaultdict, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            components.append((color, cells))
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for color, cells in components:
        groups[color].append(cells)
    colors = sorted(groups, key=lambda color: min(c for cells in groups[color] for _, c in cells))
    groups = {color: sorted(groups[color], key=len) for color in colors}
    widths = {}
    for color in colors:
        widths[color] = max(max(c for _, c in cells) - min(c for _, c in cells) + 1 for cells in groups[color])
    left_x = {colors[0]: 0}
    if len(colors) > 1:
        left_x[colors[1]] = widths[colors[0]] + 1
    lower_height = max(max(r for r, _ in groups[color][1]) - min(r for r, _ in groups[color][1]) + 1 for color in colors)
    lower_baseline = h - 1
    upper_baseline = lower_baseline - lower_height - 1
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for color in colors:
        for tier, cells in enumerate(groups[color]):
            min_r = min(r for r, _ in cells)
            min_c = min(c for _, c in cells)
            max_r = max(r for r, _ in cells)
            baseline = upper_baseline if tier == 0 else lower_baseline
            new_min_r = baseline - (max_r - min_r)
            new_min_c = left_x[color]
            for r, c in cells:
                out[new_min_r + r - min_r][new_min_c + c - min_c] = color
    return out
'''
